similarity_metric: maximum of direct, complement, reverse, and reverse-complement expected positional base-match fractions
observed_statistic: maximum similarity over every legal equal-length non-overlapping block pair, every allowed length, and all four transformations
null_model: within each null, uniformly permute all complete PWM columns without replacement; independently sampled whole permutations may repeat across null replicates; repeat the full candidate and four-transform scan for every null
